title: The Hard Work Delusion
hook: Stop bragging about how many hours you work.
script:
(Visual: Close-up of a clock ticking fast, cutting to a shot of someone looking exhausted at a laptop at 11 PM)
Narrator: In India, we treat "the grind" as a badge of honor. We equate exhaustion with achievement. 
(Visual: Cut to a minimalist graphic showing a linear line labeled "Hours" and a plateauing line labeled "Output")
Narrator: But first principles tell us that output is not a linear function of time. 
(Visual: Fast cuts of high-pressure office environments)
Narrator: Most "hard work" is actually just inefficient processing or a fear of making high-leverage decisions. 
(Visual: Direct to camera, calm expression)
Narrator: If you're working 80 hours a week to stay relevant, you aren't hardworking. You're just inefficient. The real winners don't work the most; they solve the most expensive problems.
caption: We’ve romanticized the struggle, but effort is not a proxy for value. The market doesn't pay for your sweat; it pays for the rarity of your solution. Are you actually producing, or are you just performing "busyness"? #RationalThoughts #FirstPrinciples #CareerStrategy #IndianProfessionals #CognitiveBias
